organism.evidence: MS/MS spectra were searched against the UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot human database

cell_line.evidence: HeLa cells (ATCC) were grown in Eagle’s minimum essential medium

instrument.evidence: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection

fragmentation.evidence: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%

enzymes.evidence: Samples were digested with trypsin, then analyzed by LC-MS/MS

modifications.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification

gradient_time_min.evidence: A linear 150-min gradient of 5–28% Buffer B (0.1% formic acid in acetonitrile) was used for separation

lc_column.evidence: The SPE precolumn and LC column were slurry-packed with 3-µm C18 packing material

acquisition.evidence: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing

labeling.evidence: Protein label-free quantification (LFQ) intensity revealed excellent correlations
